reason: Discord rejects bot tokens on /oauth2/@me and /oauth2/userinfo (401 Missing Access confirmed via raw curl). Both commands are user-token-only in practice; annotate pp:requires-tier: oauth2-user so live dogfood skips them on bot-tier runs instead of failing.
upstream_issue: Discord spec lists BotToken as an alternative security scheme on these paths, but the live API rejects bot tokens; generator cannot know this from the spec.
